summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a preliminary pricing supplement for a senior autocallable contingent coupon barrier note offering under its medium-term notes program. The notes are unsecured obligations linked to the worst-performing of three indices (Dow Jones, Nasdaq-100, Russell 2000) with a $1,000 face value, monthly coupon observations, and automatic call feature. No special-situation transaction—this is a routine structured product shelf takedown. No merger, acquisition, or corporate action. Risk-arb or special-situations analysis is inapplicable; focus on credit risk and market-linked payout.
